hold_text: edits .github/workflows/research-queue-dispatch.yml (adds one land-job step and a condition on the batch landing) and scripts/research/collect_runner_results.py; manager merges after green CI
why: Dispatcher cycles landed the same runs twice (PRs 27097, 27103, 27111, 27119 closed unmerged, 2026-11-19). The open-batch check ran at collect time, ~12 min before the land job, and the previous cycle's batch PR opened in between. New --prune-pending re-asks at landing time and drops staged runs already in an open results-batch PR; the batch landing is skipped when none remain. The utilization receipt is not lost: the receipt step lands comms/research/utilization separately. Fails open. Gates this adds or changes: none.
